LESSON: BELIEF IN QADAR

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.2: Belief in Qadar
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Belief in Qadar, part of Pillars of Iman in Grade 9 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why should Muslims believe in Qadar and Qadha?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

A. explain the purpose of Islamic Shariah (Maqasid al-Sharia

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Belief in Qadar in the Kenya CBC curriculum.
   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.
   At home: Explain this point to a parent using an example from your school, home, or community.

   Learning focus: This outcome is part of Belief in Qadar in the Kenya CBC curriculum.

   In class: Your teacher will guide you to discuss, practise, and demonstrate this skill using examples from Kenya.

G. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. discuss the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha in groups and make class presentations,

2. discuss the significance of believing in Qadar and Qadha in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,

3. dramatise acceptance of Qadar and Qadha.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. discuss the effects of believing in Qadar and Qadha in groups and make class presentations,
2. discuss the significance of believing in Qadar and Qadha in groups and present on charts/PowerPoint,
3. dramatise acceptance of Qadar and Qadha.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Belief in Qadar together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
